interpretations.emptyHandProfile: Null slot1/2 arrays plus no stacks linked to those slots select effect-free DropHandItems HoldStacks invalid-index paths. The first FightTable row is(UseType0,UseType0,category2), so RemoveNonCombatItems returns0 without HoldStacks for empty hands. Item drop host remains required for nonempty selected slots.
interpretations.emptyEffectProfile: Empty cached EffectStart name returns true; changing a nonempty name with token0 to empty selects CreateEffect IsEmpty early return.
interpretations.svmBeforeKill: Humanoid RagDollDead calls DEAD category2 SVM helper, stores playing time at10220e8c, then Entity StartSaySVM before Kill. Return is ignored.
interpretations.svmHelperReturn: After an admitted CanSaySVM category2 gate, SaySVM returns1 independently of the ignored StartOutput bool. Script StartSaySVM/StartSayEx/PSRoutine StartOutput wrappers returnvoid.
interpretations.speechNullAudioProfile: StartOutput first allocates/constructs retained20-byte Channel and16-byte Sound wrappers atSPU+6c/+70. Either allocation null or Self null returns false; explicit AudioModule null returns false before camera/matrix/PlayStream3D. Script wrapper ignores the bool.
